title: Cardano - Strike Finance V2 Mainnet Launch and Scaling Milestones
description:
Support the channel by donating ADA to $bonsaimasters or visit https://linktr.ee/Bonsaimasters

The provided documents detail the successful **launch and expansion of Strike V2**, a decentralized trading platform supporting the **Cardano and Ethereum networks**. Since its release, the protocol has rapidly scaled by adding high-leverage trading for major assets like **BTC, ETH, ADA, and SOL**. Technical updates have focused on **increasing position limits and deepening liquidity**, resulting in the platform surpassing **$1 million in trading volume** and thousands of individual transactions. Investor participation is notably high, with over **91% of the circulating token supply currently staked** and significant rewards already distributed to users. Future milestones include the introduction of a **native mobile app for iOS and Android**, as well as the integration of a public testnet for the **Solana network**. Overall, these updates illustrate a period of aggressive growth and high community engagement for the **Strike Finance ecosystem**.
